verdict.rationale: Martin is an AI personal-assistant service that handles user email, calendar and messages, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-usage policy or a privacy control. Community comments only voice privacy concerns and suggest the vendor build safeguards; they do not show the capability exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
